data.answer: This lists every test file associated with the target file auto_ontology/semantic/semantic_fk.py, along with the type of association recorded: either the test imports that file or its name matches the test_<name> pattern. The query reads the test-links table, filters to the requested target path, and returns the test file path and reason for each link, sorted by test file and reason.

display_annotations.note: Deterministic display links; not source citations made by the model.

data.question: Which test files cover auto_ontology/semantic/semantic_fk.py, and why are they linked?
data.reference_sql:
SELECT test_file_id, reason
FROM code.test_links
WHERE target_file_id = 'auto_ontology/semantic/semantic_fk.py'
ORDER BY test_file_id, reason;
